decisions.Kwic: 如何是理事無礙法界？師曰：東西南北。

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. an unnamed questioning monk is the exact actor. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Foxing Fatai section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who asks what the reality-and-affairs unobstructed Dharma realm is; Foxing Fatai answers, 'east, west, south, north.' All six rungs leave the questioning monk personally unnamed.

decisions.Kwic: 曰：如何是奪境不奪人？師曰：築壇拜將。曰：如何是人境兩俱奪？

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. an unnamed questioning monk is the exact actor. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Nanfeng Yunbian section. An unnamed monk is the exact speaker who asks what taking away the object but not the person is; Nanfeng Yunbian answers, 'build the altar and appoint the general.' All six rungs leave the questioning monk personally unnamed.

decisions.Kwic: 師擬對，悟劈口擊之，因墜一齒，即大悟，留天寧。

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Tang Zhongren biography. Tang Zhongren is the exact grammatical actor who is about to answer Yuanwu Keqin's urgent scriptural challenge; Yuanwu strikes him across the mouth, knocking out a tooth, and Zhongren awakens.

decisions.Kwic: 此土與西天，一隊黑漆桶，誑惑世間人

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Tui'an Xiu section. Tui'an Xiu is the exact hall speaker who calls this land and India one band of black lacquer buckets that deceive people in the world.

decisions.Kwic: 問：如何是父母未生前面目？師曰：黑漆桶。

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Juyun Chuiwan Guangzhen section. Juyun Chuiwan Guangzhen is the exact respondent who answers an unnamed monk's question about the face before father and mother were born with 'a black lacquer bucket.'

decisions.Kwic: 晨夕參請，師與唱酬無倦，一時達者稱為大慧再來。

ActorAttribution.ActorLabel: the unnamed monastic and lay followers at Tianning

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. the unnamed monastic and lay followers at Tianning is the exact actor. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Huqiu Shaolong biography. The exact grammatical actors who come morning and evening to visit and inquire are the collective monastic and lay followers denoted by 緇素; Huqiu Shaolong answers them tirelessly. All six rungs identify the teacher and place but do not supply personal names for the collective visitors.

decisions.Kwic: 終日隨波逐浪、妄生枝節者哉

Decision.AttributionNote: 續燈正統. Supplement to the Five Lamps Meeting the Source (五燈會元續略), Songxi Ziding section. Songxi Ziding is the exact informal-address speaker who contrasts Bodhidharma's single mechanism with people who spend all day following waves, chasing currents, and falsely generating branches and joints.
